title: Dynamic code evaluation from untrusted TypeScript runtime values
preconditions: untrusted data reaches an evaluation or module-loading input
generated JavaScript runtime values bypass static TypeScript types
dangerous_transitions: untrusted text is transformed into executable source
a dynamic evaluator consumes attacker-controlled source or code fragments
sink_semantics: node:vm runIn* APIs and dynamic code-generation APIs
counterevidence: Only fixed reviewed source is evaluated and untrusted input remains data.
verification_recipe: Trace attacker-controlled bytes through decoding, templating, and code generation to the evaluator.
Distinguish data arguments from source text and inspect sandbox/realm boundaries.
Use a harmless expression sentinel and a non-evaluating control.
